native_only_guards: Content shrink and viewport resize clamp offsets before a separate metrics query.
Direct C enum values preserve independent overflow axes and reject an invalid value.
Detached and display:none elements return no metrics and zero dimensions.
Owned metrics copies survive mutation and document destruction.

nonqualifying_prior_attempts.reason: C overflow-axis literal parsing and enum transport were incomplete.
Native inset length literals and shared engine application were incomplete.

policy: Open UI never executes JavaScript. Consuming native applications call public Rust methods and Rust callbacks over the retained engine. Chromium is the sole pixel target.

operations: Native Rust click callback changes em/rem inset lengths.
Left/top auto and right/bottom percentages position the retained element.
Weak handles expire after document teardown.

read_only_checks.qualification_note: Read-only generator, archive integrity and repository-accountability checks over an unchanged clean umbrella checkpoint. This is not a renderer pixel qualification run.
